claim.claim_text: Regular physical activity lowers blood pressure in adults

evidence.title: Aerobic exercise and blood pressure in adults: a meta-analysis of randomised trials (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Across 54 trials of adults, aerobic exercise significantly reduced systolic and diastolic blood pressure compared with control.

evidence.title: Muscle fibre composition in elite cyclists (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Biopsies of cyclists' muscle fibre types; blood pressure was not assessed.

claim.claim_text: Measles vaccination prevents measles infection in children

evidence.title: Effectiveness of measles-containing vaccines in children: systematic review (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Two doses of measles vaccine were 97% effective at preventing laboratory-confirmed measles in children.

evidence.title: Measles vaccine coverage and outbreak size in school districts (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Districts with higher vaccine coverage had significantly fewer and smaller measles outbreaks among children.

claim.claim_text: Smoking increases the risk of lung cancer

evidence.title: Cigarette smoking and lung cancer risk: a meta-analysis of cohort studies (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Current smokers had a substantially increased risk of lung cancer compared with never smokers, with a clear dose-response relationship.

claim.claim_text: Oral rehydration solution reduces deaths from diarrhoea in children

evidence.title: Oral rehydration therapy for acute diarrhoea in children: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Children randomised to oral rehydration solution had significantly reduced mortality and need for intravenous fluids compared with standard care.

evidence.title: Taste preferences for flavoured rehydration drinks (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Children rated fruit flavours higher than unflavoured solutions.

claim.claim_text: Vaccines cause autism

evidence.title: Measles, mumps and rubella vaccination and autism: a nationwide cohort study (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Among 650,000 children, MMR vaccination was not associated with an increased risk of autism (hazard ratio 0.93).

evidence.title: Vaccines and autism: a meta-analysis of case-control and cohort studies (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Pooled data from 1.2 million children found no association between vaccination and autism.

claim.claim_text: Vitamin C supplements prevent the common cold in the general population

evidence.title: Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold: systematic review (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. In the general population, regular vitamin C supplementation did not reduce the incidence of colds; there was no significant difference versus placebo.

claim.claim_text: Hydroxychloroquine cures COVID-19

evidence.title: Hydroxychloroquine in hospitalised patients with COVID-19: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Hydroxychloroquine did not reduce 28-day mortality and showed no clinical benefit compared with usual care.

evidence.title: Hydroxychloroquine inhibits SARS-CoV-2 replication in Vero cells (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. In cultured cells, hydroxychloroquine reduced viral replication in vitro.

claim.claim_text: Drinking hot water cures the flu

evidence.title: Hot fluids and symptoms of common cold and flu: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. A hot drink relieved nasal and throat symptoms, but did not shorten the duration of illness; no difference in recovery time.

claim.claim_text: Coffee raises the risk of heart disease

evidence.title: Coffee consumption and coronary heart disease: a cohort of 400,000 adults (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Moderate coffee intake was associated with a lower risk of coronary heart disease.

evidence.title: Unfiltered coffee and cardiovascular events: a cohort study (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Heavy consumption of unfiltered boiled coffee was associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular events.

claim.claim_text: Vitamin D supplements reduce the risk of fractures in older adults

evidence.title: Vitamin D with calcium and hip fracture in elderly women: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Vitamin D plus calcium significantly reduced hip fractures in institutionalised older women.

evidence.title: Vitamin D alone and fracture risk in community-dwelling older adults: meta-analysis (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Vitamin D supplementation alone did not reduce total or hip fracture; no significant difference versus placebo.

claim.claim_text: Low-carbohydrate diets lead to greater weight loss than low-fat diets

evidence.title: Low-carbohydrate versus low-fat diets for weight loss: 12-month randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Weight loss was significantly greater in the low-carbohydrate group at 12 months.

evidence.title: Healthy low-fat vs healthy low-carbohydrate diet and weight change: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. There was no significant difference in 12-month weight loss between the low-fat and low-carbohydrate diets.

claim.claim_text: Herb X boosts immunity by 300% in people

evidence.title: Herb X extract enhances macrophage activity in mice (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Mice fed herb X extract showed increased macrophage activity compared with controls.

evidence.title: Phytochemical profile of herb X leaves (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Chromatographic analysis identified 14 flavonoids in herb X leaves.

claim.claim_text: Lemon water cures cancer

evidence.title: Lemon peel extract induces apoptosis in breast cancer cells (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Lemon peel extract reduced viability of cultured breast cancer cells in vitro.

evidence.title: Citrus intake and cancer incidence: a cohort study (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Higher citrus fruit intake was associated with a modestly lower incidence of some cancers; treatment was not studied.

claim.claim_text: Garlic cures tuberculosis

evidence.title: Allicin inhibits Mycobacterium growth in culture (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Allicin reduced growth of mycobacteria in vitro at high concentrations.

claim.claim_text: Melatonin improves sleep in toddlers

evidence.title: Melatonin for insomnia in older adults: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. In adults over 65, melatonin significantly improved sleep onset latency compared with placebo.

claim.claim_text: Ivermectin cures long COVID

evidence.title: Resolution of post-COVID fatigue after ivermectin: a case report (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. A single patient reported improvement in fatigue after a course of ivermectin.

claim.claim_text: Honey cures sore throat infections

evidence.title: Honey for acute cough in children: systematic review (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Honey probably reduced cough frequency slightly more than no treatment; infection outcomes were not measured.

claim.claim_text: This green tea feels amazing in the morning

evidence.title: Green tea catechins and cardiovascular risk factors: meta-analysis (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Green tea intake was associated with small reductions in LDL cholesterol.

claim.claim_text: My grandmother's soup is the best comfort food when you are sick

evidence.title: Chicken soup inhibits neutrophil chemotaxis in vitro (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Chicken soup had a mild inhibitory effect on neutrophil migration in cultured cells.

claim.claim_text: Yoga makes you feel more connected to your inner self

evidence.title: Yoga for chronic low back pain: randomised trial (synthetic)
evidence.abstract: Synthetic. Yoga significantly reduced back pain scores compared with usual care at 12 weeks.
